disk_note: Rows are separate directory/file measurements; do not blindly sum overlapping or hard-linked paths. Logical bytes do not count followed symlink targets. Model cache includes actual blobs and metadata. Source row includes bundled selftest WAV. Rust executable is a host prototype, not a full feature-equivalent app.

recording_growth.note: 16 kHz mono PCM16, keep_all_audio=true. Excludes SQLite/filesystem overhead.

sampling_note: Fixed single shared worker retains state. Runtime order was Rust,Rust,Python,Python,Python,Rust; three observations per host, not an isolated full-app memory A/B. Host import timing and PSS depend on OS cache/shared pages. Combined memory differences include worker pool/state variation.
